selection_rationale.7:9: strict rank 1 and edge-aware rank 2; strongest cross-rule candidate
selection_rationale.13:15: strict rank 3 and edge-aware rank 6; second cross-rule high candidate
selection_rationale.3:7: edge-aware rank 3; edge-only boundary candidate outside strict support

identity.required_rule: every candidate and both comparators have the exact same ordered identities with no missing, duplicate, or extra samples

execution.cache_policy: offline existing caches only; no download or mutation
stages: one limit=5 structural smoke over all four cells without scientific metric inspection
after exact four-of-four terminal and identity closure, one analysis and one verifier

analysis.primary_question: does any outcome-blind variable-width candidate exceed the current best 12:15 on the exact MMLU test population
analysis.paired_delta_units: fraction internally and percentage points for display

bootstrap.iteration_order: replicate-major then draw-major over canonical test identity order
bootstrap.joint_index_reuse: one identical index stream for every candidate-minus-12:15 and candidate-minus-baseline contrast
bootstrap.percentile_interval: linear interpolation at q*(R-1) for q=0.025 and 0.975

analysis.exact_mcnemar: two-sided exact binomial on paired candidate versus 12:15 correctness
analysis.holm_family: four candidate-versus-12:15 exact McNemar tests; step-down family-wise alpha=0.05
always_report: paired delta and 95% CI versus baseline
observed candidate ranking and regret to observed candidate oracle

labels.TARGETED_VARIABLE_WIDTH_STRONG_IMPROVEME: best candidate delta versus 12:15 is positive, its paired-bootstrap lower 95% bound is greater than 0, and its Holm-adjusted McNemar p is below 0.05
labels.TARGETED_VARIABLE_WIDTH_POINT_IMPROVEMEN: best candidate point accuracy exceeds 12:15 but the strong criterion is not satisfied

outputs.raw_cell_outputs: one isolated smoke and one isolated full namespace per ordered candidate

non_objectives: exhaustive full evaluation of all 168 windows
claiming a global optimum over every width or model-task cell
changing K, fixed horizon, model, dataset, renderer, cache, decode, or loop strategy
tuning selector scores from P3-G outcomes
P3-H, cross-model, cross-task, or adaptive per-input selection

gate_terminal.success: all four frozen full cells complete on exact identities and recipe, analysis and verifier agree, and the frozen science label is reported honestly
